pages: Leave Policy. Casual leave: employees receive 12 days of casual leave per calendar year. Unused casual leave does not carry forward.
Sick leave: employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than 3 consecutive days.
Maternity leave is 26 weeks of paid leave. Paternity leave is 15 working days, to be taken within 6 months of the birth.
IT Security Standard. Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must be rotated every 180 days. Password reuse of the last 10 passwords is not allowed.
Laptops must use full-disk encryption. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the security desk within 24 hours.
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, VPN and all production systems.
Travel and Expenses. Economy class is required for flights shorter than 6 hours. Business class may be approved for flights longer than 6 hours.
The daily meal allowance for domestic travel is 1500 rupees. Hotel bookings must be made through the corporate travel portal.
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the trip with itemised receipts.
Benefits Guide. Group health insurance covers the employee, spouse and up to two children, with a sum insured of 5 lakh rupees.
The company matches provident fund contributions at 12 percent of basic salary.
Employees may claim a learning budget of 40000 rupees per year for approved courses and certifications.
